points.label: PuntPoints
points.note: PuntPoints are loyalty points for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. They have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for money.

credits.label: Pay-As-You-Go credits
credits.note: Credits unlock premium features and tools one use at a time. Credits cannot be sent to other members or refunded as cash.

prices.title: What credits unlock
prices.note: Puntr Pro members use these features without spending credits.
